findings.title: Price arithmetic not guarded against exceeding safe integer range
findings.why: dailyPrice × days, and full × 90 inside rentalTotal, can exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER for large but individually valid prices. The total then silently loses precision, which breaks the integer-cents requirement. I found no check on the computed total.

findings.title: Cancel spec has an unresolved clarification marker and no plan or tasks
findings.why: FR-004 (the refund rule) is still marked [NEEDS CLARIFICATION], the spec has no plan or tasks, and cancel() is not implemented. The spec is documentation only, so it should not be read as ready.
